en.text: God spoke all these words, saying,

footnotes.text: 20:1 After “God”, the Hebrew has the two letters “Aleph Tav” (the first and last letters of the Hebrew alphabet), not as a word, but as a grammatical marker.

zhSimplified.text: 神吩咐这一切的话说：

zhTraditional.text: 上帝吩咐這一切的話說：

en.text: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

zhSimplified.text: 「我是耶和华—你的 神，曾将你从埃及地为奴之家领出来。

zhTraditional.text: 「我是耶和華－你的上帝，曾將你從埃及地為奴之家領出來。

en.text: “You shall have no other gods before me.

zhSimplified.text: 「除了我以外，你不可有别的神。

zhTraditional.text: 「除了我以外，你不可有別的神。

en.text: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

zhSimplified.text: 「不可为自己雕刻偶像，也不可做什么形象仿佛上天、下地，和地底下、水中的百物。

zhTraditional.text: 「不可為自己雕刻偶像，也不可做甚麼形像彷彿上天、下地，和地底下、水中的百物。

en.text: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

zhSimplified.text: 不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉它，因为我耶和华—你的 神是忌邪的 神。恨我的，我必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三四代；

zhTraditional.text: 不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉它，因為我耶和華－你的上帝是忌邪的上帝。恨我的，我必追討他的罪，自父及子，直到三四代；

en.text: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

zhSimplified.text: 爱我、守我诫命的，我必向他们发慈爱，直到千代。

zhTraditional.text: 愛我、守我誡命的，我必向他們發慈愛，直到千代。

en.text: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God, for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

footnotes.text: 20:7 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
20:7 or, You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain

zhSimplified.text: 「不可妄称耶和华—你 神的名；因为妄称耶和华名的，耶和华必不以他为无罪。

zhTraditional.text: 「不可妄稱耶和華－你上帝的名；因為妄稱耶和華名的，耶和華必不以他為無罪。

en.text: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

zhSimplified.text: 「当记念安息日，守为圣日。

zhTraditional.text: 「當記念安息日，守為聖日。

en.text: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,

zhSimplified.text: 六日要劳碌做你一切的工，

zhTraditional.text: 六日要勞碌做你一切的工，

en.text: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;

zhSimplified.text: 但第七日是向耶和华—你 神当守的安息日。这一日你和你的儿女、仆婢、牲畜，并你城里寄居的客旅，无论何工都不可做；

zhTraditional.text: 但第七日是向耶和華－你上帝當守的安息日。這一日你和你的兒女、僕婢、牲畜，並你城裏寄居的客旅，無論何工都不可做；

en.text: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.

zhSimplified.text: 因为六日之内，耶和华造天、地、海，和其中的万物，第七日便安息，所以耶和华赐福与安息日，定为圣日。

zhTraditional.text: 因為六日之內，耶和華造天、地、海，和其中的萬物，第七日便安息，所以耶和華賜福與安息日，定為聖日。

en.text: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

zhSimplified.text: 「当孝敬父母，使你的日子在耶和华—你 神所赐你的地上得以长久。

zhTraditional.text: 「當孝敬父母，使你的日子在耶和華－你上帝所賜你的地上得以長久。

en.text: “You shall not murder.

zhSimplified.text: 「不可杀人。

zhTraditional.text: 「不可殺人。

en.text: “You shall not commit adultery.

zhSimplified.text: 「不可奸淫。

zhTraditional.text: 「不可姦淫。

en.text: “You shall not steal.

zhSimplified.text: 「不可偷盗。

zhTraditional.text: 「不可偷盜。

en.text: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

zhSimplified.text: 「不可作假见证陷害人。

zhTraditional.text: 「不可作假見證陷害人。

en.text: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”

zhSimplified.text: 「不可贪恋人的房屋；也不可贪恋人的妻子、仆婢、牛驴，并他一切所有的。」 （申5·22—23）

zhTraditional.text: 「不可貪戀人的房屋；也不可貪戀人的妻子、僕婢、牛驢，並他一切所有的。」 （申5‧22－23）

en.text: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.

zhSimplified.text: 众百姓见雷轰、闪电、角声、山上冒烟，就都发颤，远远地站立，

zhTraditional.text: 眾百姓見雷轟、閃電、角聲、山上冒煙，就都發顫，遠遠地站立，

en.text: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”

zhSimplified.text: 对摩西说：「求你和我们说话，我们必听；不要 神和我们说话，恐怕我们死亡。」

zhTraditional.text: 對摩西說：「求你和我們說話，我們必聽；不要上帝和我們說話，恐怕我們死亡。」

en.text: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”

zhSimplified.text: 摩西对百姓说：「不要惧怕；因为 神降临是要试验你们，叫你们时常敬畏他，不致犯罪。」

zhTraditional.text: 摩西對百姓說：「不要懼怕；因為上帝降臨是要試驗你們，叫你們時常敬畏他，不致犯罪。」

en.text: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.

zhSimplified.text: 于是百姓远远地站立；摩西就挨近 神所在的幽暗之中。

zhTraditional.text: 於是百姓遠遠地站立；摩西就挨近上帝所在的幽暗之中。

en.text: The LORD said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：「你要向以色列人这样说：『你们自己看见我从天上和你们说话了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：「你要向以色列人這樣說：『你們自己看見我從天上和你們說話了。

en.text: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.

zhSimplified.text: 你们不可做什么神像与我相配，不可为自己做金银的神像。

zhTraditional.text: 你們不可做甚麼神像與我相配，不可為自己做金銀的神像。

en.text: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.

zhSimplified.text: 你要为我筑土坛，在上面以牛羊献为燔祭和平安祭。凡记下我名的地方，我必到那里赐福给你。

zhTraditional.text: 你要為我築土壇，在上面以牛羊獻為燔祭和平安祭。凡記下我名的地方，我必到那裏賜福給你。

en.text: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.

zhSimplified.text: 你若为我筑一座石坛，不可用凿成的石头，因你在上头一动家具，就把坛污秽了。

zhTraditional.text: 你若為我築一座石壇，不可用鑿成的石頭，因你在上頭一動家具，就把壇污穢了。

en.text: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’

zhSimplified.text: 你上我的坛，不可用台阶，免得露出你的下体来。』」

zhTraditional.text: 你上我的壇，不可用臺階，免得露出你的下體來。』」
